WITH site_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    sm.zoneref,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(sm.facetfaces) as site_avg_faces
  FROM scanmesh sm
  INNER JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sm.zoneref, s.entrystat
),
overall_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(site_avg_faces) as baseline
  FROM site_avgs
),
status_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.entrystat,
    AVG(sa.site_avg_faces) as status_avg
  FROM site_avgs sa
  WHERE sa.entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sa.entrystat
),
kept_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.site_avg_faces,
    ob.baseline,
    st.status_avg
  FROM site_avgs sa
  INNER JOIN status_avgs st ON st.entrystat = sa.entrystat
  CROSS JOIN overall_baseline ob
  WHERE sa.site_avg_faces > st.status_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(site_avg_faces) as avg_faces,
  AVG(site_avg_faces - baseline) as avg_exceed_baseline,
  AVG(site_avg_faces - status_avg) as avg_exceed_status
FROM kept_sites
